# Rendered polecat directive size in bytes: the ratchet ceiling that
# TestDirectiveCeiling holds the committed directive to (internal/cmd/directive_size_test.go).
# It moves only down. A commit that cuts a rule or merges two lowers this number
# to the size it renders; no commit raises it.
# The target is 12 KB (12,288 bytes), set in docs/design/rework-program.md item 4.
# The number below is the polecat directive's rendered size as TestDirectiveCeiling
# renders it as of this commit: 3,096 bytes over the target.
15384
